children: Silo Pharma entered into securities purchase agreements with accredited investors for a private placement of 136,005 common shares at $1.50 per share and pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 430,661 shares at $1.4999 per warrant. The warrants are immediately exercisable at $0.0001 per share, subject to ownership limits, and the placement closed on November 6, 2026. The company expects net proceeds of approximately $815,000 for working capital and general corporate purposes.
